<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/aivision/adVariation"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Generate ad variation with manual prompt or auto analysis mode.

**Modes:**
- `manual`: Provide a custom prompt to guide the ad variation generation
- `auto`: Automatically analyze the image and generate variations

**Supported Models:**
- Gemini (default)
- Flux
- Other available models
